productSpec.title: Agencia Alfa Core Web Experience
productSpec.problem_statement: Initial architecture and high-conversion web experience for Agencia Alfa (saas-b2b).

user_experience.primary_flow: User triggers action from UI -> System responds with <100ms INP tactile feedback and deterministic state updates.
user_experience.visual_theme: OKLCH 90/8/2 Perceptual Palette + Utopia Fluid Typography + Minimal Surface Hierarchy

acceptance_criteria: Zero UI layout thrashing or horizontal overflow across 1440px, 768px, and 390px viewports.
100% WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility compliance (semantic landmarks <main>, <nav>, ARIA labels, APCA contrast).
Zero inline executable <script> blocks or inline onclick handlers (strict CSP compliance).

techSpec.title: Agencia Alfa Core Web Experience — Architecture & Technical Spec
techSpec.architecture_tier: Vanilla JS/CSS + Cloudflare Workers Static Assets
security_invariants: Untrusted input rendered strictly via textContent or escaped template literals.
Zero eval() or new Function() calls.
All remote network calls protected by AbortSignal.timeout(2500-3500ms).
